entities.name: Tayva
entities.description: Older, grayer necromancer cousin of Loria, cold and immune to poison.

entities.name: Loria
entities.description: Younger necromancer cousin of Tayva who poisoned her and died of plague.

entities.name: Ebnezzer
entities.description: Dark mage who taught them necromancy and was later possessed and killed by them.

entities.name: dark spirit
entities.description: Evil entity that possessed Ebnezzer, then the lake's waters, then Winton.

entities.name: Winton
entities.description: Hunter killed by the cousins who rose undead possessed by the lake spirit.

entities.name: World Spell
entities.description: Event that drained the cousins of most necromantic power.

events.summary: Ebnezzer teaches the cousins necromancy and they turn their household into zombies.
events.quote: they slowly turned their entire household into servile zombies

events.summary: The World Spell drains the cousins' power and leaves Ebnezzer possessed by a dark spirit.
events.quote: leaving Ebnezzer possessed by a dark spirit

events.summary: They kill Ebnezzer and put his head into a lake, where the spirit takes possession of the waters.
events.quote: They killed Ebnezzer and took his head with them north into the backwoods.

events.summary: Loria poisons Tayva's food but Tayva, immune and having served plagued meat, survives; Loria dies of the plague on the shore.
The undead Winton, possessed by the lake spirit, drags both cousins into the waters.
events.quote: The lake spirit did not want either of the cousins to leave the swamp and dragged them both into the waters.

relations.quote: Tayva and Loria were necromancer cousins
The dark mage Ebnezzer taught them necromantic magic
They killed Ebnezzer and took his head with them north into the backwoods.
